class_name: 添加-非限定-ニカギラズ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Takes a bare noun and states that what follows holds beyond it, either adding a coordinate case (子供に限らず大人も) or opening onto a wider set (日本に限らずどこの国でも); a following も is usual. It is the formal, written counterpart of だけでなく. The affirmative に限り／に限って means "only in the case of", and に限る "nothing beats" is a separate pattern despite the shared kanji.

examples.ruby: この病気[びょうき]は大人[おとな]に限[かぎ]らず、子供[こども]もかかる。
examples.english: This illness isn't confined to adults; children come down with it too.

examples.ruby: 渋滞[じゅうたい]は週末[しゅうまつ]に限[かぎ]らず、平日[へいじつ]の朝[あさ]にも起[お]きる。
examples.english: Traffic jams aren't just a weekend thing; they happen on weekday mornings as well.

examples.ruby: 電子[でんし]決済[けっさい]は都会[とかい]に限[かぎ]らず地方[ちほう]でも広[ひろ]がっている。
examples.english: Electronic payment is spreading beyond the big cities into the regions too.
